title: testaruda Agent Output v1
description: JSON Schema for testaruda --agent output format. See TIA-AGENT-001 through TIA-AGENT-007.

changed_units.description: Content units that changed in the code change set

selected.description: Selected tests with reason chains explaining why each was selected

skipped.description: Tests that were candidates but not selected, with exclusion reasons (TIA-AGENT-003)

coverage_gaps.description: Symbols that changed but have no covering test (TIA-AGENT-006)

SummaryStats.description: Summary statistics for the agent output

candidate_count.description: Number of tests with direct stored dependencies on changed units; safety fallbacks can make this smaller than selected_count

has_coverage_gaps.description: Whether any coverage gaps were detected

ChangedUnit.description: A content unit that changed in the selection

id.description: Store ID of the content unit

path.description: File path relative to project root

unresolved.description: Whether the unit was unresolved (cold-start or missing file)

SelectedTestInfo.description: A selected test with its reason chain

id.description: Store ID of the test item

distance.description: Minimum distance from a changed unit (hops)

always_run.description: Whether this test is in the always-run set

quarantined.description: Whether this test is selected for monitoring but excluded from pass/fail trust calculations

fallback_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this test is in the always-run state. Present when always_run is true.

reason_chain.description: Reason chain: witness edges explaining why this test was selected

ReasonEdge.description: A step in the reason chain for a test selection

content_unit_id.description: Content unit ID this edge points to

origin.description: Origin of the dependency edge (static, runtime, manual)

path.description: Path of the content unit (resolved from store)

SkippedTestInfo.description: A test that was a candidate but not selected

id.description: Store ID of the test item

CoverageGap.description: A coverage gap: a changed symbol with no covering test

file.description: File path where the symbol is defined
